purpose.zh: 撑住L撑，练双腿分开再并拢的控制
purpose.en: Hold an L-sit and control your legs as they open and close.

text.zh: 撑住不落地，伸直的双腿慢慢分开再并拢
text.en: Stay up on your hands and slowly open and close your straight legs
Press your shoulders down and keep your arms straight.

text.zh: 整组腿一直离地，膝盖不弯。
text.en: Keep your legs off the floor the whole set, knees straight.

commonErrors.en: Bending your knees or touching your feet down.

cautions.zh: 手腕不舒服时先活动一下手腕
cautions.en: If your wrists feel stiff, warm them up first.

cautions.zh: 手腕或肩膀疼时少做一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your wrists or shoulders hurt, do less, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: EN 名改 Title Case：L-sit → L-Sit
节奏按 spec open 轨：分开 1.0 s / 停 0.5 s / 并拢 1.0 s / 休 1.5 s；口令顺序改成 分开→停→并拢（原 peak「合拢」、end「稳住」错位）
flags: 批表主轨是平的、换用 feet 轨（go 0.53/hold 0.87）不可信，按 spec 手算；动画一次循环里两下之间只停 0.5 s、循环接缝处停 2.5 s，rest 取平均 1.5 s
